comment: restore.c getlev() under REST_CURRENT_LEVEL calls mon.c restore_cham() for every monster on the hero's level (restore.c:1217). A vampire created with the debug-mode create-monster command arrives as a fog cloud; killed, it rises as a vampire with cham NON_PM (mon.c vamprises()). After the save and restore, restore_cham() gives it back its shapeshifter index, so each turn m_calcdistress() reaches decide_to_shapeshift()'s healthy-vampire rn2(6). New seed, clock and character.
